intentAndPurpose.intent: Animated brand-coloured indicator that visualises the four canonical agent states (idle, listening, thinking, speaking) using the OneUI logo geometry. Recolours per brand and adapts on coloured surfaces.

props.name: aria-live
props.description: Live region politeness for screen readers.

props.name: autoTransition
props.description: Skip the bridge animation between states.

props.name: emphasis
props.description: Tinted colour emphasis (Figma: Agent pulse is always tinted).

props.name: label
props.description: Override the auto-derived a11y label (e.g. "Agent is thinking").

props.name: size
props.description: Figma dimension-token size, legacy preset, or pixel override.

props.name: state
props.description: Visual state. Component plays the matching loop and auto-runs a bridge animation between states when one exists.

interactionBehavior.summary: AgentPulse is presentational, not a control: no hover, press, or focus styles, no click handler, and no tab stop — `state` / `paused` are props, not gestures. It is a `role="status"` live region (`aria-live` defaults to `polite`, overridable to `off` or `assertive`) named by `label` or the state default (`"Agent is idle"` / `listening` / `thinking` / `speaking`), with the same string repeated in a visually hidden node so the live region has text content. The SVG mark is `aria-hidden` and `focusable="false"`. Listening and speaking audio only subscribe while the pulse is on-screen and not `paused`; an off-screen instance will not start playback. Inherit the parent's cursor — it does not set one. Twelve keyframes drive the visual states — `agentPulseIdle` / `-IdleSettle`, `agentPulseThinking`, the four `agentPulseTransitionInPill*` steps with their cluster in/out counterparts, and `agentPulseFade`. Under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` the `.pill` and `.cluster` animations are switched off with `!important` (and the `.fallbackPulse` SVG with them), so `state` still changes the appearance but nothing moves.
